source: Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries of Preah Vihear Province (មន្ទីរកសិកម្ម រុក្ខាប្រមាញ់ និងនេសាទ ខេត្តព្រះវិហារ), presentation "ដំណើរការផលិតកម្មគ្រាប់ពូជស្រូវសុទ្ធ" (Process of Pure Rice Seed Production), presented by Ms. Yem Sokey (យឹម សុគី), Deputy Head of the Office of Agricultural Techniques and Agricultural Productivity, dated 20 November 2017. Contact: ysophy168@gmail.com, 012 558 312.
text:
When choosing a location to make a seedling nursery bed (ថ្នាលសំណាប) for pure rice seed production, select land that is level/flat and fertile. Do not choose a site under trees, because tree roots compete for nutrients and moisture with the seedlings. The nursery site should be located near a water source, but must not be a low spot that can be flooded or submerged by overflow water.

A plot chosen to become a seedling nursery should not have been used as a nursery bed under a tree canopy before (the field should not already have volunteer/leftover seedlings growing under a tree canopy).

When multiple nursery beds are prepared for different varieties, the beds must be spaced apart from each other, with a minimum distance of 5-10 meters between beds of different varieties, and each bed should have a clear marker/label. The beds should be separated from each other by a clean, clearly visible boundary line so that when irrigating, water carrying seed or soil does not flow between adjoining beds and mix varieties together.

When two nursery beds of different varieties are directly adjacent to each other within the same field, it is preferable to sow them at different times (staggered sowing dates) so that any accidental mixing between the two can be more easily detected by observing differences in growth stage.
